title: Running totals
description: running_totals(numbers) should return a new list in which each item is the sum of all the numbers up to and including that position.

bug.summary: The function returns the running number total instead of the list totals.
location_patterns: what (the function|it) (returns|gives back) at the end

tests.description: a negative number in the middle

hints.1: Compare the kind of value the description asks for with the kind of value your function gives back.
hints.2: Look at the return statement on line {line}, and at the two variables that change inside the loop.
hints.3: The return statement hands back the running number rather than the list built in the loop, so the caller gets a single int. Check which of your two variables matches what the description asks for.
